body:
## Position Changes the Attention Kernel

A position method alters which query-key relationships are easy to express. It is part of the model’s learned similarity rule, not a decorative tag.

Relative biases can directly favor or penalize distance buckets. Rotary methods encode distance through angles; absolute methods add location vectors to content.

Extrapolation fails when the model encounters frequencies or distances outside its learned behavior. Evaluate retrieval and reasoning at controlled positions, not only average long-context scores.
